migration_flags.description: stock.move has no group_id field in this tree (grep over stock_move.py returned no lines). reference_ids, a Many2many to stock.reference over stock_reference_move_rel, is used for picking assignment keys, procurement values and orderpoint triggers. The _assign_picking docstring still says procurement group. Code or data that read the procurement group of a move must be remapped. Earlier-version behaviour is baseline knowledge, not verifiable here.

The move carries a single quantity field computed as the sum of move-line quantities (round=False) and serving as reserved and done quantity. No quantity_done or reserved_availability field exists; the product_qty inverse raises a UserError. Stale comments remain at L2059 and L2405.
picked is a stored compute with inverse; _action_done validates only picked moves with positive quantity (or inventory adjustments) and removes unpicked move lines of picked moves.

location_final_id is stored and writable with no compute and no copy attribute (so it is copied by split and duplication); location_dest_id is a computed intermediate destination that is replaced by the final location when the final location lies inside it. Procurement writes the final location. Both are merge keys.

to_refund (copy=True, default=True) is declared in stock_account, while stock/models/stock_rule.py writes it for negative procurement quantities without a module guard and sale_stock carries it in _get_custom_move_fields. Installations without stock_account are a risk to verify.

mts_else_mto exists only on the rule; the move stores make_to_stock or make_to_order. _run_pull maps the rule value, _action_confirm uses it to choose confirmed plus a procurement request, and _adjust_procure_method falls back to make_to_stock for any other rule value.

allowed_uom_ids (product unit, packaging units, supplier price list units) drives the product_uom domain; stock_move.py declares no unit-category field and no constraint of any kind. Data that relied on a unit-category constraint on the move must be re-validated.
purchase_stock overrides _prepare_extra_move_vals and calls the parent, but this tree has no base definition, no _create_extra_move and no caller. The additional flag remains.

Reservation timing is controlled by reservation_date and the picking-type reservation_method (at_confirm, manual, by_date); _trigger_assign honours the system parameter stock.picking_no_auto_reserve. Forecast fields are not read by _action_assign.

restrict_partner_id is the owner restriction (no owner_id field on the move); returns use origin_returned_move_id and returned_move_ids (no return_line_ids). The state selection has seven values while the help text lists five.
_adjust_procure_method has callers only in mrp and repair code and one test; no base stock code calls it.
_compute_quantity docstring describes rounding while the code uses round=False; quants_cache in _action_assign is never read again in stock_move.py; _create_backorder compares at Product Unit digits.

key_findings.state_machine: state is a stored read-only Selection with seven values (help lists five). _action_confirm picks waiting (chained or make_to_order) or confirmed; _action_assign and _recompute_state write assigned or partially_available; _action_done writes state done and date in one write for picked moves; _action_cancel writes cancel and propagates through move_dest_ids and move_orig_ids.
key_findings.reservation: _action_assign has a bypass branch, an unchained branch (quant reservation in non-strict mode at the source location) and a chained branch (strict reservation limited to quantities delivered by finished origin moves and not taken by siblings). _trigger_assign re-reserves waiting moves when stock arrives, ordered by priority, date and id.
key_findings.procure_method: Two stored values (make_to_stock, make_to_order); mts_else_mto exists only on the rule. A make_to_order move passes itself as destination move in its procurement values so the rule-created move is chained in front of it.
key_findings.backorder_split: _create_backorder compares quantity with demand at Product Unit digits and hands the missing quantity to _split, which copies the move through copy_data; new moves are confirmed without merge and without procurement.
key_findings.merge: Merge compatibility is a fixed distinct-field list including location_final_id and restrict_partner_id; sale_stock, purchase_stock and mrp add their own keys.
key_findings.v19_relations: No group_id; reference_ids Many2many to stock.reference; location_final_id stored and writable; to_refund declared in stock_account.
key_findings.extensions: 32 files extend stock.move; fields were inventoried only for mrp, sale_stock, purchase_stock and stock_account (pointer only).
